fact: Cabo Verde's data protection commission CNPD recognised the need to give the country a law to regulate artificial intelligence, after setting out the data protection rules that bear on AI.

Cabo Verde's Prime Minister told the National Assembly that social media and artificial intelligence are used to manipulate and violate constitutional limits on free expression in the absence of any mechanism of regulation and accountability, and that AI needs regulating.

Cabo Verde's National Elections Commission president said that until the country has a legal regulatory framework, countering AI-amplified electoral disinformation rests on inter-institutional collaboration with platforms, universities and media.
